instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-03_input.step. The input is a 150 x 86 x 8 mm base plate. Add and fuse eight parallel heat-sink fins on the top face. Every fin runs along X from X=18 to X=132 and is 3.5 mm thick in Y, with bottom on Z=8. The fin center Y coordinates are 14, 22, 30, 38, 46, 54, 62, and 70 mm. The corresponding fin heights are 28, 18, 32, 18, 28, 22, 32, and 18 mm. Cut a through obround ventilation slot in the base only, centered at (75,43), length 78 mm along X and width 12 mm. Cut four base through holes of diameter 6 mm at (20,16), (130,16), (20,70), and (130,70). Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-03_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
